howToAdd: Copy this file to .resolve/context-packs.json. Fill in your product, the journey step (for example checkout summary), and who the screen is for. Bind recipeIds to recipes you already have — use the recipe id (checkout-summary), not the title. Optional files lists product/client workspace labels or keys. Optional client when product ≠ client. Never add Figma component ids; recommend fills those after ingest. Set active to the pack agents should load by default.
